name: hustl
description: hustl. — creator–brand marketplace: Next.js frontend, Node microservices, FastAPI AI backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r ai-backend/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev:creator: npm --prefix backend run dev:creator
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend,ai "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start" "cd ai-backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.start:creator: npm --prefix backend run start:creator
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && cd ai-backend && python -m app.db.migrate
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test && cd ai-backend && python -m pytest -q
